plan.rationale: A solo tattoo artist selling personal style and trust. Ink-editorial palette and modern-display type suit the craft without cliche. Sections cover styles, approach, hygiene and process, each grounded in what Mags actually said. Photo slots requested since none exist yet. No pricing or claims invented.

sections.headline: Expertly crafted tattoos, uniquely you
sections.subheadline: Tats by Mags turns your ideas into personalised tattoos, worked out together with you from first sketch to final line.

photoSlot.brief: A photo of Mags at work in the studio, tattoo machine in hand, taken from the side so the setup is visible

sections.heading: Your canvas, our passion
paragraphs: At Tats by Mags, tattoos are treated as more than ink on skin. They are stories, expressions of individuality and lasting works of art, and the aim is always to create something you will cherish for a lifetime.

Mags is the heart and soul of the studio, a passionate and talented tattoo artist who specialises in black and grey realism, watercolour and fine line work, each design built to reflect your personality and style.

items.title: Personalised designs
items.body: Mags works closely with you to create custom designs that are uniquely yours, not templates pulled off a wall.

items.title: Attention to detail
items.body: Meticulous artistry and precision go into every piece, from the first sketch to the final pass of the needle.

items.title: Comfortable atmosphere
items.body: The studio is clean, relaxed and welcoming, so you feel at ease throughout the whole process.

items.title: Exceptional service
items.body: A positive and memorable experience is the goal from your first message to the finished tattoo.

items.name: Black and grey realism
items.description: Detailed, shaded work built to look lifelike.

items.name: Watercolour
items.description: Soft, flowing colour effects for a painterly finish.

items.name: Fine line
items.description: Delicate, precise linework for subtle, detailed pieces.

steps.title: Consultation
steps.body: You bring your ideas and Mags listens, so the design starts from what the tattoo means to you.

steps.title: Collaborative design
steps.body: Together you work through the details of the design until every element feels right.

steps.title: Final check
steps.body: Every detail is confirmed and agreed before the needle touches your skin.

steps.title: The tattoo
steps.body: Using single-use needles and inks, and following all health and safety regulations, in a clean and relaxed studio setting.

sections.heading: Hygiene and safety come first
sections.body: Your safety is treated as paramount. The studio maintains high standards of hygiene and sterilisation, using only single-use needles and inks and adhering to all health and safety regulations throughout.

photoSlot.brief: A photo of the sterilisation and setup area, showing single-use needles and inks laid out before a session

items.question: Do I need to know exactly what I want before contacting you?
items.answer: No. Bring your ideas, however rough, and Mags will collaborate with you on the design from there.

items.question: Is this suitable for a first tattoo?
items.answer: Yes, whether it is your first tattoo or an addition to an existing collection, the same collaborative process applies.

items.question: What hygiene standards does the studio follow?
items.answer: Single-use needles and inks are used for every session, and the studio adheres to all health and safety regulations.

items.question: Where is the studio based?
items.answer: Tats by Mags is based in Hartbeespoort, North West.
